concepts.why: The presence of a large polypoid mass in the nasal cavity, CD138 and CD56 positivity, EBV positivity, and genetic gains at multiple loci are consistent with Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

The presence of a large polypoid mass in the nasal cavity and genetic gains at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6) and 8q24 (MYC), could be consistent with Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, although the CD20 negativity and CD138 positivity are atypical.
The CD20-negative and PAX5-negative findings are consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma, which often lacks these B-cell markers.
